representations.name: Euclidean point-sphere incidence hypergraph
representations.new_information: Retains the actual point coordinates, positive squared-distance labels, sphere centres, multiplicities, and simultaneous incidences across every row instead of replacing them by independent Laurent identities.
representations.first_test: Test whether anisotropic grids, Cartesian products, sphere clusters, and the full-Euclidean interval multirow model create the forbidden bicliques or ruled components that the incidence estimate must isolate.

representations.name: Polynomial-partition cells with ruled exceptional locus
representations.new_information: Retains ambient dimension three and the location and scale of incidences; separates generic cells from planes, spheres, cylinders, and doubly ruled exceptional surfaces where distance coincidences concentrate.
representations.first_test: Perform the exponent ledger for a partition degree D and verify that all Cartesian-grid and ruled-surface examples are charged to an explicit exceptional branch rather than hidden in an O-term.

representations.name: Positive dyadic distance-energy ledger
representations.new_information: Keeps unsigned pair counts, dyadic spatial scale, distance-shell scale, and cross-scale mass, so cancellation in signed quotients cannot erase Euclidean realizability.
representations.first_test: Compute the ledger on cubic grids, planar layers, two-scale clusters, and interval exact blocks; reject any inequality that gains only by assuming uniform shell mass.

representations.name: Gram PSD and equilibrium-stress certificate
representations.new_information: Encodes squared distances through a positive-semidefinite Gram matrix of rank at most three and retains compatibility among all labelled edges, which abstract row graphs and group-ring masks forget.
representations.first_test: Test the proposed stress-rank implication on flexible frameworks, cospherical configurations, the coherent-theta Euclidean no-go, and exact interval multirow realizations.

representations.name: Simultaneous Laurent common-object datum
representations.new_information: Retains in one object F_j=GR_j, P_A0=GB, B=R_jQ_j, P_Aj=F_0Q_j, scalar copies of one X, and height/tangent parameters; this is stronger than rowwise factorization.
representations.first_test: Replay the simultaneous-positive, multidirectional-tensor, binary-box Phi6, interval-multirow, and fixed-five-point coprimality countermodels at their exact hypothesis levels.

representations.name: Truncated moment and Hankel reconstruction
representations.new_information: Retains signed coefficient locations and multiplicities through moments m_k(Q_j), while Hankel rank measures the number of exponential atoms without requiring coefficientwise positivity or Fourier conditioning.
representations.first_test: Compute exact Hankel ranks for the known signed escapes and search for positive-multiple quotients with many support atoms but anomalously small initial Hankel rank.

representations.name: Scalar-copy Jacobian and transcendence ledger
representations.new_information: Keeps the common source X and all scalar parameters lambda_j in a single coefficient map; Jacobian rank can distinguish genuine scalar copies from tensor switches built from unrelated sources.
representations.first_test: Check rank on binary boxes, cyclotomic same-line families, the five-point aperiodic source, and mixed-source tensor switches; reject it if translation, reflection, or scaling symmetries consume the claimed rank.

representations.name: Row-cell defect measure and bounded coarea potential
representations.new_information: Retains where near-equality defects occur across rows, tangent cells, labels, and scales; a normalized bounded potential can select one coherent power-large core without a union bound over rare bad cells.
representations.first_test: Construct distributed-defect arrays in which every row is individually good but no common core survives, and determine the exact overlap or conservation hypothesis needed for coarea selection.

representations.name: Multilinear row-cell-distance tensor
representations.new_information: Records simultaneous dependence among row, tangent cell, source pair, and distance label; slice or partition rank is sensitive to shared labels that disappear after rowwise projection.
representations.first_test: Evaluate rank on tensor switch cubes and interval multirow exact blocks, checking whether low rank follows from product structure without implying few Euclidean distances.

representations.name: Multiscale tangent-cone and reciprocal-chart atlas
representations.new_information: Retains the reciprocal ruled-chart parameters, sign, denominator scale, and nesting of tangent directions across scales, rather than only a common Newton direction.
representations.first_test: Place the full interval and coherent-theta constructions in the atlas and test whether bounded chart multiplicity fails before the required t^(5/9-o(1)) scale.
